column1: # The authoritative 16-colour palette, plus foreground and background.
# Tab-separated: slot, role, hex. Slots 0-15 are the ANSI indices; `fg` and `bg`
# are the default foreground and background.
# This is the source of truth. `generate.sh` renders it for each terminal, and
# the same values appear in nvim/lua/config/palette.lua, which states the
# dependency. Neovim keeps cterm highlights authoritative and inherits these 16
# colours from whatever terminal it runs in, so a terminal that does not match
# this table renders the editor wrongly.
